the role of lipids in cardiovascular disease and in particular the role of lipoproteins.
the relationship between serum lipoprotein levels and cardiovascular disease.
the relation of serum high density lipoproteins (HDL) to the risk of coronary heart disease (CHD), a relation that has been the subject of much recent interest.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the inverse relation of HDLD and cardiovascular disease is not an artifact of analytic methodology.
the inverse relation between high density lipoproteins and coronary heart disease is real and not an artifact of analytic methodology.
